entries.subject: Create the mobile-only SPA.cz partner app proposal
entries.body: Established the eight-area Czech and English app flow from the existing SPA.cz partner-panel functionality, mapped it to the supplied Szallas design system and SPA.cz brand, and added reproducible review, state, comment and Figma-export tooling. This bootstrap entry is replaced by commit-derived history when the repository workflow runs.
